name: trellis_workspace_describe
description: Index status and limits. Per language, `coverage` counts native syntax tuples and `semantic` reports the selected imported producer (for example rust-analyzer or scip-typescript SCIP): `available` is true when it is fresh and covers documents, with its own tuple counts, so partial coverage of either stays visible. Call this first.

name: trellis_find_symbols
description: Find declarations by literal name or ID substring (no regex). Returns symbol IDs for the other tools, with line ranges. Results are native declarations; `scopeCoverage` also reports each language's selected semantic evidence, and `syntaxOnly` appears only for returned languages without it.

query.description: 1–1024 UTF-8 bytes; no trimming or normalization.

name: trellis_search_symbols
description: Rank declarations for a natural-language or code query (lexical plus local vector search when available). Returns symbol IDs for the other tools. Relevance is not proof; `scopeCoverage` reports each language's selected semantic evidence.

name: trellis_declaration
description: Read one declaration's measured record (signature header, ancestors, range and lines) by symbol ID. No body; use trellis_read_source with the returned lines.

name: trellis_outgoing_calls
description: List the calls made inside one declaration, with semantic bindings and targets where a fresh imported producer covers the language, else syntax-only name hints. Default limit 6 (max 50). Each distinct semantic basis appears once in `semanticBases`, referenced by `semanticBasisRef` and provenance `basisRef`; `compact:true` omits bindings, coverage and provenance for a much smaller answer.

name: trellis_incoming_calls
description: Find call sites whose callee name matches one declaration (name match, not proof), each annotated with its semantic binding where one is selected. Default limit 6 (max 50); production callers first. Each distinct semantic basis appears once in `semanticBases`; `compact:true` omits bindings, coverage and provenance, so 50 callers fit easily.

name: trellis_read_source
description: Read up to 200 lines (16 KiB) of indexed source by path and 1-based inclusive line range, from the cached snapshot, never the live disk.

name: trellis_call_graph
description: Build a bounded rooted call graph from one declaration, expanding only fresh exact semantic bindings. Without imported evidence every edge stops at the root; use trellis_outgoing_calls instead.

name: trellis_references
description: Read pinned native-module and external-package references: structural syntax sites, plus fresh semantic call and type bindings where a producer is selected. Production and test sites are separate. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null.

name: trellis_rules_check
description: Check reviewed architecture rules against pinned evidence without writing files. Call/type constraints use fresh semantic bindings where available; otherwise they remain unknown. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null.

name: trellis_rules_explain
description: Explain one exact architecture rule instance at a pin, including unknowns and reviewed exceptions. Results page at about 24 KiB: repeat the call with `offset: page.nextOffset` until it is null.
